integrity: The proof is analytic. The only packaged computation checks the closed-form coefficient against direct numerical quadrature and is not used as evidence for the infinite asymptotic statement.
scientific limitations: Fixed-dimension asymptotic for the canonical all-vertex truncation only; no uniform-in-dimension remainder, no optimization over perturbations, and no claim about the globally optimal stability exponent beyond the demonstrated canonical witness.
title: Exact nth-order Gaussian ell-norm defect of the canonical cube truncation
